Messages.Author: hp
Messages.Body:
I'd like a clarification about how Forced Vigilance interacts with
Aksinya Daclau's special ability:

Relevant card texts:

Aksinya Daclau:
Once each turn during a bleed against you, if Aksinya is ready and
untapped, you may discard a master card from your hand to redirect the
bleed to any other Methuselah.

Forced Vigilance
1 blood
FOR: Only usable by a tapped vampire during a (D) action directed
against you (or something you control). Untap this vampire.

I read it so that one could play FV to untap Aksinya and then use her
special ability, but I'm not sure.

Thanks in advance,
Heikki P.

>

> Yes you can, just the same as you could use forced vigilance to untap
> and then use a deflection to bounce the bleed.

Correct.

Contrast Forced Awakening, which doesn't untap her (and therefore wouldn't
work). Her special requires her to be untapped, and while Forced Awakening
allows a vampire to play reaction cards as if untapped, it says nothing about
using special abilities (or effects form cards in play or whatnot) as if untapped.

Forced Vigilance, however, untaps the vampire (and doesn't require the vampire
to attempt to block).
